governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Crossref public API coverage/query
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.version_or_commit: Living documentation; no API schema version or service deployment pinned
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: REST API description and endpoints; numbered capture 300–324
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: JSON metadata comes from members/trusted sources; no signup needed; /works search and /works/{doi} record retrieval concern Crossref records, not all DOI agencies or scholarly objects.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: A no-match is correctly treated as provider non-return, never invalidity/nonexistence. Broad bibliographic search is a realistic DOI-less candidate path.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Crossref access/limits
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Access modes / Request limits / Best practice; numbered capture 303–338
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Public access needs no authentication/identification. Polite mode supplies email through mailto or agent header; Plus is keyed/premium. Rate and interval headers and concurrency header govern requests. 429 calls for lower rate/concurrency; cache responses. Table values have no fixed interval stated in its cells.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final does not invent a requests-per-second quota, conflate public with polite, or require an account. Lead email/provider choice is an honest policy decision.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Crossref efficient API use
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Rows/cursors and bulk-query cautions; numbered capture 329–339
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Choose small useful result sets; cache; large queries can change due to reindexing; 429 requires backoff. These bulk conditions are not a claim that small pilot lookup always succeeds.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: The final's smallest-request/caching advice is bounded and not reported as an API check.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Crossref typed relations and identifiers
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.version_or_commit: Living relation-schema guide; schema release not pinned
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Vocabulary / General typed relations; numbered capture 322–340 and 372–394
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Intra-work relation names include isPreprintOf/hasPreprint, isVersionOf/hasVersion, variant and manifestation. A typed relation can target another agency's DOI or non-DOI identifier. Missing DOI causes deposit failure; non-DOI identifiers are unverified. DOI deposits create reciprocal relations; the second item's own metadata need not assert it.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final uses an analogy and source-conditioned asserted links, not universal deduplication or consumer truth. Related manifestations remain separate.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Crossref posted-content schema
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.version_or_commit: posted_content from schema 4.4.0; version/status from 5.4.0; served page 2025-07-12
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Purpose, metadata and AAM/VoR relations; numbered capture 303–350
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Guide concerns member direct XML deposits; helper tools cannot register this record type. Preprint is a type enumeration. Status values are withdrawn/removed; version number/description and status are 5.4.0 additions. isPreprintOf links to AAM/VoR. Cited-by posted content inclusion defaults off, a different operation.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final does not assert that volunteers can deposit or that every repository supplies these fields. Its local publication-kind labels are not claimed as Crossref status enum values; Cited-by default is inapplicable to proposed REST lookup.
